name: SimpleEnglish
tagline: An agent skill that makes an LLM write documentation in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English
description: SimpleEnglish is an agent skill that instructs an LLM to write documentation in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, the international standard for safe, clear technical writing. Rather than leaving tone to chance, the skill encodes the STE100 rules — controlled vocabulary, one-meaning-per-word, short declarative sentences — so generated docs come out consistent and unambiguous. It is a focused, drop-in skill for turning any LLM-based documentation workflow into standards-compliant output. Python, with 2.1k stars.
highlights: Encodes ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English rules as a reusable agent skill
Controlled vocabulary and constrained sentence structure for standards-compliant output
Drop-in for any LLM documentation workflow in Python
2.1k stars in the growing agent-skills ecosystem
curatorNote: Most LLM docs fall apart on consistency and precision; encoding an actual international writing standard as a skill is a clever fix. Exactly the kind of niche, standards-driven skill that deserves a wider audience.
